value.description: Text to fill, option to select, URL path to navigate to, or key to press. Null for click/wait.
value.title: Value

BoundingBox.description: [x, y, width, height] in CSS pixels, page coordinates.
BoundingBox.title: BoundingBox

absent.description: Elements that must NOT be present, e.g. an error banner.
absent.title: Absent

url_matches.description: Regex on the URL path only (no scheme or host), e.g. ^/repo/create$
url_matches.title: Url Matches

field.description: Dotted path in the step, e.g. target.name, action.value, expected_state.
field.title: Field

from.description: The old value (any JSON); absent or null if there was none.
from.title: From

to.description: The new value (any JSON); absent or null if there is none.
to.title: To

revision.description: Bumped on every edit; approve and edit requests must send the revision they saw.
revision.title: Revision

kind.description: task: a run of a newly approved plan, which stores a new workflow when verified. reverify: a replay of a stored workflow's steps (POST /workflows/{id}/reverify), which stores none.

plan_revision.description: The exact revision that was approved.
plan_revision.title: Plan Revision

source_workflow_id.description: reverify only: the stored workflow this run replays.
source_workflow_id.title: Source Workflow Id

workflow_id.description: The workflow this run stored. Null until a task run is verified, and always null for a reverify run (see source_workflow_id).
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

expires_at.description: Null: never expires (the only choice in the MVP UI).
expires_at.title: Expires At

category.description: The most important category among the changes; null for a same step.

summary.description: Short text for an added or removed step, e.g. 'click button “Confirm”'.
summary.title: Summary

StepChangeCategory.description: behaviour: what the step does or acts on. check: its expected state. wording: only its instruction text (the UI may collapse these). risk: its risk level.
StepChangeCategory.title: StepChangeCategory

steps.description: Every step of both versions, aligned by meaning, in the new version's order.
steps.title: Steps

scroll.description: Window scroll when the action ran (measured after scrolling the element into view). Lets a replay place bbox without relying on rrweb's scroll events, which can land just after the click.

recording_path.description: Relative artifact path to rrweb recording.
recording_path.title: Recording Path

revision.description: Number of the workflow version whose steps and recording this is (1 = as first recorded). Not the format `version` above.
revision.title: Revision

steps.description: The ordered sequence of verified steps.
steps.title: Steps

change_summary.description: How the steps differ from the parent version; null for the first.

parent_version_id.description: The version this one was made from; null for the first.
parent_version_id.title: Parent Version Id

run_id.description: The run that recorded this version.
run_id.title: Run Id

WorkflowVersionSource.description: What made the version: the first verified run, a self-heal, a regenerated plan, or a human edit.
WorkflowVersionSource.title: WorkflowVersionSource

WorkflowVersionStatus.description: current: the one shown. pending_review: waits for the owner to accept it. superseded: an older current one. rejected: the owner turned it down.
WorkflowVersionStatus.title: WorkflowVersionStatus

post.description: Signs in and sets the session cookie. Any session the browser had before is replaced.

429.description: Too many failed sign-ins; wait and retry

post.description: Revokes the session on the server and clears the cookie (also fine when already signed out).

404.description: No benchmark has written a summary yet

patch.description:
Replaces the steps (reorder / delete / edit) and bumps the revision. The same rules as for a fresh
plan apply, and the plan's risk is recomputed from its steps.

409.description: Plan already approved/rejected, or a stale revision

post.description: Approves exactly the revision the user saw and queues a run of it.

409.description: Plan already approved/rejected, or a stale revision
Plan already approved/rejected, or a stale revision

post.description: Answers a paused run: `allow` runs the paused step, `deny` cancels the run.

409.description: The run isn't paused at this step

get.description: Live view of one run. Supports `Last-Event-ID`.

parameters.description: Resume after this seq (sent by EventSource)
parameters.name: last-event-id

schema.description: Resume after this seq (sent by EventSource)
schema.title: Last-Event-Id

get.description: The tutorial's workflow, read-only: no task, run or owner ids, files under /shared/{token}/.

parameters.description: An artifact key the shared workflow references
parameters.name: key

schema.description: An artifact key the shared workflow references
schema.title: Key

post.description:
Starts planning in the background. Poll GET /tasks/{id} until it is planned, needs clarification or
failed.
Answers the planner's question and plans again.

409.description: The task isn't waiting for an answer

get.description: Stored workflows, newest first, optionally for one app (e.g. gitea).
The workflow as a plain text guide: the tutorial's step texts, numbered, each with its screenshot.

200.description: Numbered steps with one screenshot each

post.description:
Replay the stored workflow's steps headlessly, without the planner (#77). The run stores no new
workflow; its events and final status say whether every step still works.

409.description: A step is high risk or typed a secret, or the reset failed

post.description: A new read-only link. `url` holds the secret token: it is returned only here.

delete.description:
Revokes the link at once. It is kept with revoked_at set, so the owner still sees it; revoking twice is
fine.

get.description: Every version of the workflow, newest first, each with its step diff against its parent (Phase 4).
